text:
lucy: Heads up — our Python sample app is flaky during API key rotation. After we update REDWOOD_API_KEY in the k8s secret, long-lived background tasks still use the old key. Repro steps below.

lucy: Repro (simplified):
```python
# sample.py
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
async def worker():
    while True:
        await client.generate('ping')
        await asyncio.sleep(5)
```
We rotate the secret, env gets updated in the pod, but the running process keeps calling the old key.

arjun: That sounds like the client captures the key at init time and caches headers/sessions. Are you re-creating the client after rotation?

lucy: We tried reloading env inside the process but didn't re-init the client. We also tried forcing a restart but want zero-downtime rotation.

maria: If the async client keeps an aiohttp connector or session with an Authorization header set on init, swapping the env won't change the header.

sam: Could be two things: (1) SDK reads env once at construction, (2) HTTP layer caches auth header. Both fixable. Feature idea: support pluggable credential provider or an explicit refresh API.

jess: Yep — would be great to have an async-friendly CredentialProvider interface + a Client.refresh_credentials() method. Also a sample pattern for long-running workers.

lucy: Current workaround (ugly): directly mutate session headers: `client._http.session.headers.update({'Authorization': f'Bearer {new_key}'})` — works but yuck.

arjun: Filing as a feature/bug. Proposal sketch:
```py
class CredentialProvider(Protocol):
    async def get_key(self) -> str: ...
    async def on_rotate(self, cb: Callable): ...

# client ctor accepts api_key_provider (optional)
client = RedwoodClient(api_key_provider=my_provider)
```
When the provider signals rotation, client refreshes internal headers and optionally retries one failed 401.

maria: We already have a rotator infra that posts events. @rotator-bot, can we expose that as a hook for user apps?

rotator-bot: rotator-bot: yes — we emit a k8s annotation and can POST to a configured webhook `/hooks/cred-rotations`. Reach out to infra to enable for your namespace.

sam: I'll prototype `api_key_provider` param and add `await client.refresh_credentials()` + retry-once behavior for 401s. Will try to keep typing strict for AsyncClient so mypy stays happy.

jess: :thumbsup: Also add an examples/auth/rotation.py sample showing `async with RedwoodClient.from_provider(p) as client:` and SIGHUP rebind pattern.

arjun: Great. Add product/SEC approval notes if this touches KMS/HSM integrations. Also consider a small UX: `Client.from_env(reload_on_signal=True)` so users can opt-in.

sam: On it — opening WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-python-sdk/pull/1234 (will add tests and example).

maria: short-term workaround for people: watch rotator event and call `await client.close(); client = new_client_from_env()` in your process.

lucy: Thanks — I'll try the PR and the workaround. Please tag me on the PR for testing with our sample app.

sam: Will do. Thanks everyone!
